name: replace_code_section_from_file
description:
Opens a python file and modifies a section from it that can be a class or function based on a given name. This should be used to avoid rewriting entire files.
file_path: the relative path of the file.
section_name: the name of the section to search for.
replacement: the new code that will replace that named section.
This returns a success or failure message.
